en_title: Blizzard Sparks World of Warcraft Fan Backlash for 'Breaking Promise' Over Housing Microtransactions
cn_title: 《魔兽世界》家园收费被批食言
subtitle: 说好的原则呢
opus_summary: 暴雪推出两款带有库尔提拉斯风格的付费家园礼包，被玩家批评违背不售卖种族或职业主题装饰的承诺。玩家呼吁抵制购买，相关讨论在Reddit已有超过660条回复。

paragraphs.en: Back when housing was added to World of Warcraft at the beginning of Midnight , Blizzard issued a set of guiding priciples that, among other things, promised that the company wouldn't add cosmetics to the cash store that represent one of Azeroth's races or classes. This week, Blizzard broke that promise.
paragraphs.cn: 《魔兽世界》在《至暗之夜》上线之初加入家园系统时，暴雪公布了一套指导原则，其中承诺不会在现金商城上架代表艾泽拉斯某个种族或职业的外观物品。本周，暴雪违背了这一承诺。

paragraphs.en: Blizzard released two housing packs yesterday : the Haunted Grimtide Estate pack with a housing exterior and a pre-built interior, along with the Grimtide Decor Pack, which includes 21 different decorations that you can fill that interior with. The company is charging 2,500 hearthsteel for the Haunted Grimtide Estate pack and 1,000 hearthsteel for the Decor Pack, or $25 and $10, respectively.
paragraphs.cn: 暴雪昨天推出了两款家园礼包：Haunted Grimtide Estate礼包包含一套房屋外观和预先搭建好的室内空间，Grimtide Decor Pack则包含21种不同的装饰品，可用于布置这套室内空间。两款礼包分别售价2,500炉钢和1,000炉钢，对应25美元(约合人民币167元)和10美元(约合人民币67元)。

paragraphs.en: It would make sense to have a spooky decor pack ahead of Halloween, but the aesthetics of all of these items looks like they were ripped right from Stormsong Valley and the Kul'Tiran humans that debuted in Battle for Azeroth . And the problem there is that charging for packs that so directly reference a WoW race and zone goes directly against the guiding principles that Blizzard itself published when it released housing .
paragraphs.cn: 万圣节前推出恐怖风格的装饰礼包本来合情合理，但这些物品的美术风格，看起来全都像是直接照搬了《争霸艾泽拉斯》中登场的斯托颂谷地和库尔提拉斯人类。问题就在于，这些礼包如此明确地借用了《魔兽世界》某个种族和地区的风格，却要收费，这直接违背了暴雪自己在推出家园系统时公布的指导原则。

paragraphs.en: Understandably, a lot of players are upset about these housing packs. One of the biggest WoW influencers, BellularGaming, tweeted a screenshot of Blizzard's promise , adding, "Kul'tiran housing decor bundle in the store! Ever wondered why I dgaf about having a professional relationship with Blizzard anymore? When their words mean nothing, Interviews are a waste of time."
paragraphs.cn: 许多玩家对这些家园礼包感到不满，这不难理解。《魔兽世界》最有影响力的内容创作者之一BellularGaming在X上贴出了暴雪承诺的截图，并写道：「库尔提拉斯家园装饰礼包上商城了！想知道我为什么再也不他妈在乎和暴雪维持工作关系了吗？他们说话都不算数，采访就是浪费时间。」

paragraphs.en: In his replies, user LucasMillican begged players not to buy the items, saying, "Call it out, keep calling it out. Hold them accountable for their words. And for the love of god, people, don’t spend money on it. If you buy it, that tells them it’s okay. Don’t f***ing buy it."
paragraphs.cn: 在他的回复区，用户LucasMillican恳求玩家不要购买这些物品：「指出问题，持续指出问题。让他们为自己说过的话负责。各位，拜托了，别在这上面花钱。你买了，就是在告诉他们这样做没问题。别他妈买。」

paragraphs.en: Over on Reddit, WoW fans are rallying around a WindowsCentral article calling out the decor packs, in a thread that has over 660 replies at the time of writing.
paragraphs.cn: 在Reddit上，《魔兽世界》玩家正聚集在一个分享WindowsCentral批评这些装饰礼包文章的帖子下。截至发稿，该帖已有超过660条回复。

paragraphs.en: User AliceLunar said: "And now here we are, still paying a monthly fee, buying new expansions every other year.. But now we have a whole cash shop, $90 mounts, $75 tree houses, pets, skins, built in RMT, new race locked behind a $30 paywall and the list goes on. WoW has more greedy and insane monetization than a F2P MMO from 20 years ago, but it's not free to play, and people keep opening their wallet."
paragraphs.cn: 用户AliceLunar说：「现在呢，我们依然每月交月费，每隔一年买一部新资料片……可如今游戏里还有一整个现金商城，90美元(约合人民币600元)的坐骑、75美元(约合人民币500元)的树屋、宠物、皮肤、内置的真实货币交易，新种族还得花30美元(约合人民币200元)才能解锁，诸如此类，没完没了。《魔兽世界》的收费手段比20年前的免费MMO还贪婪、还疯狂，可它又不是免费游戏，大家却还在不断掏钱包。」

paragraphs.en: Another user, Tiroler_Manu , wanted Blizzard to admit it was wrong, saying, "Just openly say: 'Yeah it was a greedy f**k up move, we violated our own principles, we won't do it again, we will give all players this and former house costumizations for free and refund purchases of House customizations. House customizations from now on will not be buyable, except special (non racial) collaborations for charity events (where of course the money will go to the charity).'"
paragraphs.cn: 另一位用户Tiroler_Manu希望暴雪认错，他说：「直接公开说就行：对，这他妈就是贪婪导致的错误做法，我们违背了自己的原则，不会再犯。我们会把这次和此前的房屋自定义内容免费送给所有玩家，并退还玩家购买房屋自定义内容的费用。从今往后，房屋自定义内容将不再出售，只有为慈善活动推出的特别联动内容除外，而且不能以种族为主题，收入当然也会捐给慈善机构。」

paragraphs.en: The World of Warcraft cash shop has grown considerably over the last few years, and hasn't shown any signs of slowing down. I'm not sure if community pushback is going to do much for this specific pack, but hopefully there's a chance that it'll dissuade Blizzard from charging for other housing items that so clearly reference the races and classes that players identify with.
paragraphs.cn: 过去几年，《魔兽世界》现金商城的规模已经扩大了不少，而且丝毫没有放缓的迹象。我不确定社区的反对能在这款礼包上起多大作用，但希望这至少有机会让暴雪打消念头，不再对其他明显采用玩家所认同的种族和职业风格的家园物品收费。

paragraphs.en: This controversy is coming to one of the most popular additions to World of Warcraft in years. When Midnight first launched, housing blew up so much that players (myself included) rushed to collect a ton of housing items to create their Azerothian home. It was so popular, in fact, that Zillow even added a page to show off players' homes.
paragraphs.cn: 这场争议波及的，是《魔兽世界》多年来最受欢迎的新内容之一。《至暗之夜》刚上线时，家园系统火爆到包括我在内的玩家都争相收集大量家园物品，打造自己在艾泽拉斯的家。事实上，它的人气高到连Zillow都专门新增了一个页面，展示玩家的家园。
